post.text:
We got our first bit of new info on The Elder Scrolls 6 in over 7 years:

Todd Howard has confirmed TES6 will have MORE TREES than Skyrim! https://t.co/k1xTJNGbtP
post.author_description: Game Reviewer & Content Creator | Threads/Reviews/News | As featured on @RockstarGames @NME @ComicBook @IGN | Turn on notifs!🔔 | Contact: ameer@synthpotato.com

description.description: A close-up of a middle-aged man with brown hair, in a gray t-shirt, stands in the Bethesda Softworks office. He is looking at the camera and talking, gesturing with his hands. Behind him, there's a staircase and a logo on the wall.

tweetMedia.transcription: Are there going to be more trees in the Elder Scrolls VI, Mr. Aram, or less? Are there going to be more trees in Elder Scrolls VI or less? More. Most definitely more.
